messages:
sophia: Quick kickoff — we need a concrete plan for the calibration/prompt-set for the upcoming INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ bakeoff. thinking about coverage vs noise.
liam: Agreed. main constraints: 5k budget for calibration tokens, want stratified coverage across products + length buckets.
anika: Can We define clear strata? product type, intent class, avg token length, and failure-mode tags (hallucination, formatting, arithmetic).
marc: +1 on failure-mode tags. Also add 'system-prompt variants' as a small axis — we saw quant sensitivity on system templates last time.
tara: For deployment profiles, remind that dedicated latency targets differ: we care about 4-token tail latency for hosted, but dedicated can trade more tokens for cost. so calibration should include short (<=16), mid (17-128), long (>128).
sophia: Good. Proposal: build 5 strata by product (search, summarization, chat, code-assist, extraction) x 3 length buckets x 4 failure tags. sample 10 anchors per cell + 15 probes. anchors are deterministic golden prompts. probes are noisy real production samples.
liam: That math -> 5*3*4*(10+15) = 5*3*4*25 = 1500 prompts. leaves room to double for holdouts/test.
anika: We should reserve a 30% holdout stratified by the same buckets for final regression checks. also include a negative-control set (nonsense, prompt-injection toycases) ~200.
sophia: For anchors: curate from high-confidence human-labeled examples and add 'edge-case' anchors for known quant failures (long code blocks, nested tables). label each anchor with expected normalized output signature (e.g., JSON schema) to enable structured diff.
marc: For probes, sample from production logs but strip PII and normalize tokens. we'll need sampling code. e.g.:
```
# stratified sample by product/len/failure_tag
python scripts/sample_strata.py --input prod_logs.jsonl --out calib_pool.jsonl --strata-config strata.yaml --seed 42
```
liam: For randomness reproducibility, use seeds per-stratum and store them in dataset metadata. also record tokenization metrics (byte-pair token counts) so we can match model sequence-length distributions later.
tara: Eval metrics we care about: exact match when schemaed, EM@k for generative, and a soft similarity (BLEU/ROUGE) for free-form. but we also need an error-rate delta map per failure_tag.
anika: Add a small 'golden-checker' harness that runs on quantized model and full-fp baseline and outputs a per-example diff with classification: OK, MISMATCH, TRUNCATED, MALFORMED. eval-bot: automated run scheduled: bakeoff-calib-run-1 queued, eta ~48h once datasets up.
sophia: Decision items: 1) final strata yaml, 2) anchor selection owner, 3) probe-sampling window (last 90 days?), 4) token budget cap. volunteers?
marc: I can own strata yaml and sampling script.
aniKa: I'll lead anchor selection and schema labels. (typo corrected)
sophia: thanks — liaM, can you handle PII scrub scripts + add tokenizer stats export?
liam: yep, will add to scripts. planning to output stats at: s3://redwood-experiments/calib/1938501120/token_stats.json.gz
tara: Also we should include a tiny 'stress' shard: 50 very-long chained instruction prompts to exercise KV cache behavior and prompt prefix caching.
anika: Good call. we'll annotate them as "stress/kv-warmup".
sophia: Timeline: collect anchors + probes in 72h, run internal smoke on 24h after that, then queue eval-bot bakeoff. leaving thread for updates. :rocket:
marc: Done — created PR draft for scripts, link in thread when ready.
liam: Uploaded initial sampling tool to the branch. will ping with PR link. :thumbsup:
anika: starting anchor curation now, posting selection checklist in docs.
sophia: perfect. thanks team.
eval-bot: bakeoff-calib-run-1 status: waiting_on_dataset (reminder ping in 48h).
